audience: Russian-speaking Hearthstone readers with independent HearthPulse accounts
goals: Implement a gentle dark Manacost cabinet using real saved data

user_journeys.name: Edit profile
user_journeys.success: Open editor, save name/bio/class/avatar and optional Twitch or YouTube links through the versioned API, then return to overview

user_journeys.name: Join discussion
user_journeys.success: Consent and publish once; guest sees avatar/name/profile link and verified paid title

direction.name: Manacost gentle dossier shared UI v8
direction.thesis: One maintained control system: a soft twilight cabinet and an editorial-white discussion surface
direction.signature: A quiet warm-gold masthead, one softened profile passport with the real class crest, and restrained outbound social links
direction.rationale: Owner asked for a more pleasant, gentle cabinet without a generic dashboard or a bright redesign; lower contrast surfaces and a warmer accent preserve mature Manacost character while making editing calmer
avoid: Hard card outlines and heavy shadows

typography.display: Existing Roboto Condensed with Arial fallback
typography.utility: Existing Roboto Condensed with Arial fallback
typography.rationale: Keep current site Cyrillic families; no new font download; Cabinet is 32–44px while the reader name is 32–48px

shadows.policy: Restrained depth inside account; no shadow-heavy comment cards

responsive.containers: Existing Newspaper 1068/980/740px inner grid; 24px desktop and 16px mobile profile padding, intrinsic account layout and article-width comments; same capabilities on mobile

quality.accessibility: Keyboard, visible focus, labeled controls, status announcements and real errors, 44px actions, native Account disclosure with Escape focus return, 4.5:1 body contrast and labelled external links
quality.performance: No added libraries, fonts or third-party embeds; fixed avatar geometry; scoped CSS/JS; compare local cold/warm layout and transfer evidence
quality.seo: hs-manacost.ru remains canonical; hs-manacost.com noindex mirror; test.hs-manacost.ru fully noindex
quality.media: Keep existing covers/header/artwork and safe avatar API
quality.ads: The account-only asset owner deliberately dequeues ad assets from /account/; article ad slots and view counting are unchanged
quality.analytics: The account-only asset owner deliberately dequeues analytics assets from /account/; articles retain existing analytics and no new identity tracking is added

vertical_slices: Cabinet masthead and profile passport hierarchy
Dedicated profile editor with visible photo preview and optional social links
Compact transparent discussion and public profile with consented links only
implementation.dependencies: Existing reader BFF and Newspaper; no native WP accounts/comments

rollout.staging_evidence: Required exact-SHA reader browser suite and live staging shell/login checks; evidence recorded in release task
rollout.approval_owner: Site owner requested frontend/form redesign in the existing Manacost navy direction
rollout.template_restore: No Cloud Template assignments changed; rollback first-party source only, keep live DB
